_readme: Copy this file to goal-tests.config.json next to goals-runner.sh and edit it. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

notify._channels_help: Any of: stdout, macos, webhook, smtp. Add webhook or smtp once their settings below are filled in.
notify._webhook_help: Better: leave this empty and put GOAL_TESTS_WEBHOOK_URL=https://... in secrets.env (chmod 600).
